name: Tarn Linnorm
savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Curse of Death
defensiveAbilities.description: When a creature slays the tarn linnorm, it must succeed at a DC 46 Will save or it can no longer recover Hit Points via any means, such as healing spells, the Medicine skill, or natural healing from rest. This has an unlimited duration.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike (Tail Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
3d6+18 bludgeoning, DC 44 basic Fortitude save

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Corrosive Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
The tarn linnorm can expel either a 120 foot line or a 60 foot cone of acid, dealing 20d6 acid damage to creatures within the area (DC 44 basic Reflex save).

The linnorm can't use Corrosive Breath or Double Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

The acid creates toxic fumes. At the beginning of the linnorm's next turn, those who failed the breath weapon's Reflex save must succeed at a DC 42 Fortitude save or gain Sickened 4 from the poisonous fumes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Double Bite
offensiveAbilities.description: The tarn linnorm Strides and then makes a jaws Strike with each of their heads, each against a different target. Both attacks count toward the tarn linnorm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the tarn linnorm makes all of these attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Double Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
The tarn linnorm uses Corrosive Breath twice. A creature attempts only one save and can take damage only once.

The linnorm can't use Corrosive Breath or Double Breath again for 2d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tarn Linnorm Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 44 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 7d6 acid damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 11d6 acid damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

lv8spells.name: Truesight (Constant)
lv8spells.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

lv9spells.name: Unfettered Movement (Constant)
lv9spells.description: You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to Escape an effect that has them Immobilized, Grabbed, or Restrained, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.

description:
Although more powerful linnorms exist, the multi-headed tarn linnorm can wreak an awe-inspiring amount of devastation.

Immense, primeval dragons of the northern reaches of the world, linnorms hate those they deem to be lesser creatures and seek to inflict as much suffering as possible upon their unfortunate victims. While these serpentine monstrosities might not be the powerful winged dragons most imagine, they nonetheless possess incredible strength and deadly powers that often rival more notorious dragons' brutality.
